title: ochna afzelii subsp. congoensis
intro: Ochna afzelii subsp. congoensis, commonly known as the Congo ochna, is a plant species that belongs to the family Ochnaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal disorders. The health benefits of Ochna afzelii subsp. congoensis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects.
